imperials.songTitle: Christmas Card from a Hooker in Minneapolis
imperials.line: And I still have that record of Little Anthony and the Imperials
stanza: And hey Charlie, I think about you every time I pass a fillin' station
On account of all the grease you used to wear in your hair
And I still have that record of Little Anthony and the Imperials
But someone stole my record player--now, how do you like that?

materials.songTitle: Come On! Feel the Illinoise! (Part I: The World’s Columbian Exposition – Part II: Carl Sandburg Visits Me in a Dream)
stanza: And I cried myself to sleep last night
They may sound just right to me
